actionability.rationale: Authors receive clear selection rules, construction constraints, rejection conditions, and verification steps.

concision.rationale: The packet is necessarily detailed but generally avoids padding; constraints and exceptions prevent concrete authoring errors.

nonRedundancy.rationale: Rules have clear canonical owners and downstream files normally link to them rather than restating them.

specificity.rationale: Guidance consistently specifies ownership, valid variants, thresholds, inputs, exceptions, and acceptance checks.

findings.excerpt: Apply the canonical [title anchor and wrapping contract](index.md#action-title-block) to action titles.
findings.reason: The linked component section delegates the canonical anchor and wrapping rules to the design owner, making this route indirect for an instruction presented as canonical.
findings.recommendedChange: Call this the action-title-block contract, or add a direct link to the design typography/anchor rule alongside the existing component link.

judgement.summary: All 54 manifest files were reviewed. The guidance is accepted: it is specific, operational, and consistently routed to canonical owners; the one minor routing clarification does not undermine use.
